Our leadership

Prophet Joseph
Adegboyega Ologbonyo

Zonal Superintendent

Prophet Joseph Adegboyega Ologbonyo is an ordained pastor in Christ Apostolic Church and the founder of CAC Boanerges W/W. He serves as Zonal Superintendent of CAC Boanerges Zonal Headquarters in Ojodu Berger, Lagos.

About the content on this website

The church name, Lagos address, Zonal Superintendent title and district leadership details were supplied by the church website’s organiser. The pastor’s Facebook profile describes him as an ordained CAC pastor and founder of CAC Boanerges W/W. The service schedule comes from the worship flyer supplied by the church website’s organiser. The displayed flyer and logo are approved, AI-polished versions of the supplied artwork.

Welcome messages and taglines are original website copy, not quotations from Facebook. Scripture quotations are attributed to the King James Version. The worship photograph is illustrative stock imagery, not a verified photograph of this congregation. Lagos contact numbers and the start time for Lagos Power Night have not yet been supplied.
